series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: Convert bar-to-bar close diffs into a discrete alphabet {U,D,F}, build a Suffix Automaton over historical Price DNA in O(n), then query the recent dna_window for longest_match; dna_score=longest_match/dna_window in [0,1] is a real-time pattern-familiarity sensor (not a loss counter).
data_needed: Close series of length history_length+dna_window; discrete char codes from signed close diffs; SA extend/get-longest-match.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: Min-max normalize recent raw closes into [0,1], pass through bottleneck autoencoder (encoder h=σ(We x+be), decoder x′=σ(Wd h+bd)), compute MSE reconstruction loss, map to confidence C=1/(1+MSE) in [0,1]; C→0 when geometry becomes unreadable (macro shock / structural break).
data_needed: Normalized recent_raw price window of length dna_window; AE weights/biases; MSE between x and x′.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD H4; AE toggled on/off vs Suffix-Automaton-only; same 2025/2026 window
why_new_for_mis: Proactive structural-integrity / break sensor from reconstruction error—detects regime change before consecutive losses, complementary to discrete pattern match.
quote: When reconstruction error rises, C moves toward zero, and the position size is reduced.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: Fixed-size reservoir of k prices with replacement probability P=k/i via isolated LCG (not MathRand); modes yield mean of fair sample, (min+max)/2 midpoint, mean±std_dev volatility pull, or 0.3*mean+0.7*price recent bias—memory-bounded stream sensor of continuous-trend price level.
data_needed: Streaming closes; reservoir size k; samples_seen; deterministic LCG seed; optional std-dev of reservoir.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY H4; trailing class CTrailingReservoirLinReg; opt 2025, forward early-2026
why_new_for_mis: Statistically fair fixed-memory price distribution sensor for continuous trending regimes—avoids SMA lag tails and unbounded history buffers.
quote: Given that every time the stream has an equal likelihood k/i of ending up in the reservoir, the sample remains evenly balanced over time.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
